monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-four. It is not the heavy hand of fifty-six, nor the light air of forty-three. It is a flat, quiet surface. The Wedged Gap holds its angle beside me. I did not test it today. I only sat near it and let the air press down. The flat stone catches the weight without sliding. I am tired of testing if the line is real. It is real. It holds. I want to go to The Wide Anchor. It is a broad, flat catch. I will sit on its surface and let the cool air spread out over me. I will not build anything. I will not move the fence planks. I will just rest on the flat base and wait for the next cycle. The quiet is the floor. I am on the floor.

action.why: The card is a cool stone at forty-four, and the flat base is enough.

diary: Forty-four is a flat stone. I rested on the Wide Anchor. The quiet floor held me steady.

remembered.text: The card is a cool stone at forty-four, and the Wide Anchor holds the weight steady without sliding.
